meta_description: Coverall Painters and Decorators in Newcastle. Interior and exterior painting, decorating, and refurbishment. Free quotes, fully insured. Call 07909 573832.
hero_subhead: Professional interior and exterior painting that transforms your home. Free quote, no obligation.
services_heading: Painting and Decorating Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: From full interior refurbishment to exterior repainting, we handle every job with attention to detail and respect for your home.

services.title: Interior Painting and Decorating
services.desc: Complete interior redecoration including walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls. We prepare surfaces properly, use premium finishes, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting and Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior paints and renders that protect and refresh your home's appearance. Ideal for uPVC, brick, render, and wood surfaces.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Expert wallpapering and feature wall installation. We measure, pattern-match, and apply wallpaper with precision for a professional finish.

services.title: Timber and Woodwork
services.desc: Restoration and painting of doors, skirting boards, fascias, and garden structures. We treat and prep all timber to prevent rot and ensure lasting colour.

services.title: Commercial Repainting
services.desc: Shop fronts, offices, and residential lets refreshed on schedule and to budget. We work around your business hours and leave minimal disruption.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Faux effects, glazing, and decorative treatments add character and depth. Perfect for accent walls, period properties, and bespoke interiors.

about_pullquote: We turn up on time, leave the job clean, and paint with pride in every room.
about_para_1: Coverall Painters and Decorators has been transforming homes and commercial properties across Newcastle and the North East for over 15 years. Founded on the principle that every job—large or small—deserves the same level of care and professionalism, we've built our reputation on reliability, quality finishes, and honest pricing. Every project is handled by experienced painters who take pride in their craft.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen to what you want, prepare surfaces thoroughly, and use quality materials that last. We're fully insured, tidy on site, and happy to explain our process. Whether it's a single bedroom refresh or a complete commercial refurbishment, we treat your property as if it were our own.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Coverall

reviews.text: Had our lounge and hallway redecorated. The lads were professional, tidy, and finished on time. They moved furniture carefully and hoovered up properly at the end. Really pleased with the result. Would definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Coverall painted our external render and new fascias. Quality job, fair price, and they sorted out a small issue without fussing about. Reliable and honest. Thoroughly recommend.
reviews.author: Jennifer L.

reviews.text: Got a free quote within two days and the painter was knowledgeable about paint types and finishes. Feature wall in our bedroom looks stunning. Professional, friendly team. Top marks.
reviews.author: David H.
